lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Wednesday. Rehearsal. Ivy's big trick: "Elephant Toothpaste." [pause] A volcano of foam... out of a magic hat.

lines.speaker: IVY
lines.text: [dramatic] Ladies and gentlemen! [pause] From this ordinary hat, I will now pull out... a—

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [flatly] A volcano of foam. I know.

lines.speaker: IVY
lines.text: [surprised] ...How do you know that? I didn't tell you that.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Every time something went wrong... you reset. [pause] And again. [pause] And again.

lines.speaker: IVY
lines.text: [laughing] Okay, okay, what if I sneeze in the middle and the foam goes—

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [not laughing] —on the ceiling. Yeah. Don't do that.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You lived Thursday four hundred and twelve times. [pause] Until the trick was perfect. [pause] Until YOU were perfect.

lines.speaker: IVY
lines.text: [hurt, quiet] You don't laugh anymore. You're never surprised. [pause] It's like you're not even here.

lines.speaker: IVY
lines.text: [softly] You know how we became friends? [pause] Kindergarten. You glued your hand to my backpack.

lines.speaker: IVY
lines.text: [sad smile] Best mistake you ever made. [pause] ...I miss that guy.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: [proud] Why did the pancake go to the—

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: [bored] —doctor. It felt flat. Dad, I know. [pause] I know ALL of them.

lines.speaker: BEA
lines.text: [tiny voice] You're not fun anymore. [pause] Even Gary thinks so.
